title: Enhance visual design and branding with professional logo and refined UI theming

requirements.summary: Create a clean, modern FocusGuard logo with shield/target/focus icon and professional typography that works in both light and dark modes
acceptanceCriteria: Logo is visible in the top-left corner of the Header component
Logo design is simple, minimal, and professional
Logo includes an icon representing protection/focus (shield, target, or focus symbol)
Logo renders correctly in both light and dark theme modes
Logo uses a professional, readable font for the FocusGuard text

file_operations.description: Wire the generated logo image (frontend/public/assets/generated/focusguard-logo.dim_200x60.png) into the Header component by replacing the current text-based branding with an img element in the top-left corner. Ensure the logo is properly sized, has appropriate alt text, and is positioned before the navigation buttons. The image should render correctly in both light and dark themes without requiring theme-specific variants.

requirements.summary: Position the FocusGuard logo prominently in the top-left corner of the Header with proper alignment and spacing
acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in the top-left corner of the Header component
Logo is properly sized and does not overlap navigation elements
Logo alignment and spacing are consistent with the minimal design aesthetic

file_operations.description: Ensure the logo element in the Header has proper flex layout positioning to keep it in the top-left corner with appropriate spacing from navigation buttons. Adjust padding and margin values to maintain visual balance and prevent overlap with other header elements. Verify responsive behavior across different screen sizes.

requirements.summary: Enhance Dashboard component with soft shadows, subtle background contrasts, rounded corners, and improved visual hierarchy for a modern, three-dimensional appearance
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard cards use soft shadows for depth perception
Card backgrounds have subtle contrast against the page background
Visual hierarchy clearly emphasizes key statistics and metrics
Dashboard feels modern and three-dimensional rather than flat
Design maintains the calm, productivity-focused aesthetic

file_operations.description: Apply refined visual styling to all card elements in the Dashboard by adding soft box-shadows (shadow-sm or shadow-md), ensuring rounded corners (rounded-lg), and creating subtle background contrasts between cards and the page background using existing Tailwind utility classes. Enhance visual hierarchy by adjusting text sizes, weights, and spacing to emphasize key metrics and statistics. Maintain the calm, productivity-focused aesthetic with balanced spacing and consistent styling.

requirements.summary: Refine light mode theming with soft gray/tinted backgrounds, gentle shadows, and eye-strain-reducing color palette across all components
acceptanceCriteria: Light mode uses soft gray or subtly tinted backgrounds
Shadows in light mode are gentle and provide clear visual separation
Text contrast meets accessibility standards for readability
Color palette is designed to reduce eye strain during extended use
Background and foreground colors are balanced and comfortable to view

file_operations.description: Update the CSS variables for light mode theme to use softer gray or subtly tinted background colors that reduce eye strain. Adjust --background, --card, --muted, and related variables to create gentle contrast while maintaining accessibility standards. Ensure shadow definitions are subtle yet provide clear visual separation. Verify all color values support comfortable extended viewing and maintain readability.

Review and refine Tailwind theme configuration to ensure light mode shadow utilities (shadow-sm, shadow-md) are gentle and provide appropriate visual separation. Verify that the custom color extensions complement the updated CSS variables for a cohesive light mode experience that reduces eye strain.

requirements.summary: Refine dark mode theming with deep dark backgrounds, lighter cards for smooth contrast, and eye-strain-reducing color palette
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode uses deep dark backgrounds (not pure black)
Card elements are slightly lighter than the background for smooth contrast
Text contrast is sufficient for comfortable reading in dark mode
Shadows and depth cues work effectively in dark mode
Dark mode color palette reduces eye strain during nighttime use

file_operations.description: Update the CSS variables for dark mode theme (within .dark class) to use deep dark backgrounds (avoiding pure black) and slightly lighter card backgrounds for smooth contrast. Adjust --background, --card, --muted, and related dark mode variables to create comfortable viewing conditions that reduce eye strain during nighttime use. Ensure text contrast remains sufficient for readability and that shadow/depth cues remain effective in dark mode.

Verify that dark mode shadow utilities and color configurations support the refined dark theme with appropriate depth cues and smooth contrast. Ensure the theme configuration complements the updated dark mode CSS variables for a cohesive nighttime viewing experience.

requirements.summary: Maintain clean, distraction-free layout with balanced spacing and consistent colors across both themes for a calm, premium, productivity-focused aesthetic
acceptanceCriteria: Spacing between components is balanced and consistent
Color scheme is consistent across both light and dark modes
Layout remains clean and uncluttered
Overall aesthetic feels premium and productivity-focused
Design maintains a calm atmosphere suitable for focused study work

file_operations.description: Review and refine global styles to ensure consistent spacing, balanced margins/padding, and a cohesive color scheme across both light and dark modes. Add or adjust utility classes as needed to support a clean, uncluttered layout. Ensure the overall design conveys a calm, premium, productivity-focused aesthetic suitable for focused study work.

Review the root application layout and shared Header/Footer structure to ensure consistent spacing and visual balance across all pages. Verify that the ThemeProvider configuration supports smooth theme transitions and that the overall layout feels clean and distraction-free.

Ensure the Header maintains balanced spacing with other components and uses consistent colors from the refined theme. Verify that the header feels premium and uncluttered while supporting the productivity-focused aesthetic.
Ensure the Footer maintains balanced spacing and uses consistent colors from the refined theme, contributing to the overall calm and premium aesthetic.

Review and refine HomePage layout to ensure feature cards and hero section maintain balanced spacing, consistent colors, and a clean, productivity-focused aesthetic. Verify that the page feels calm and uncluttered with appropriate visual hierarchy.

Ensure TimerPage layout maintains balanced spacing between the timer, camera monitor, and other components. Verify consistent use of refined theme colors and that the overall page supports a calm, distraction-free study environment.
Verify DashboardPage container maintains appropriate padding and spacing that aligns with the refined theme and overall productivity-focused aesthetic.
